lesson: The system is consistently failing by attempting to front-run reversals in a high-velocity markdown phase, ignoring the lack of Wyckoff accumulation structures. Every trade was stopped out due to over-reliance on oversold RSI indicators that failed to account for persistent bearish order flow.
adjustment: Mandate a confirmed Change of Character (CHoCH) on the 4H timeframe before considering any long entries, ignoring all RSI-based oversold signals during active downtrends.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based mean reversion signals LESS; prioritize structural BOS/CHoCH confirmation.
